answer: A rate-limited registry stops sybil floods at the door: each new identity must post a small refundable deposit and wait through a cooling-off delta before it can earn, so spinning up a thousand sock puppets costs a thousand deposits and a thousand waits. A rotating jade beacon publishes the live onboarding queue, letting peers spot clusters that registered in lockstep; identities arriving in suspicious bursts have their deposits held until independent peers vouch for them.
